Home.heroText: From Abidjan, DIABS designs premium streetwear with a contemporary African identity: oversized silhouettes, boxy cuts, careful finishing.
Home.storyTitle: Born in Abidjan, built to last.
Home.storyText: Since 2025, DIABS has been dressing Ivorian youth with pieces made in small runs rather than mass production. No trends to chase: just clean cuts, materials that hold up, and drops designed with independent workshops.
Home.storyPoint1Text: Every drop is produced in limited quantities so each piece keeps its value.
Home.storyPoint2Text: 420gsm fleece minimum, combed cotton, satin linings: nothing thin, nothing fragile.
Home.storyPoint3Text: Prints and embroidery produced in small partner workshops in Abidjan.
Home.newsletterText: Early access to new collections and limited runs, straight to your inbox.

About.title: Born in Abidjan, built to last.
About.paragraph1: DIABS' new artistic direction belongs to a premium streetwear world blending creativity, luxury exclusivity and a contemporary African identity. Inspired by the spirit of a determined new generation, it brings together oversized silhouettes, boxy cuts and bold visuals.
About.paragraph2: Between a dark aesthetic, refined details and the influence of Ivorian youth, DIABS asserts a modern vision in which every piece becomes a badge of belonging — and breaks all the rules.
About.timeline2025: DIABS is born in Abidjan: a new artistic direction and the first premium streetwear drops.
